decision.summary: Tom gave one month's notice by email on 10 Oct. Under the Renters' Rights Act that is short; two months applies, so the earliest end is 10 Dec 2026. I replied to Tom and asked Ben whether he will agree an earlier date in writing.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? What is the earliest end date under current law?
answers.answer: No. Tenants need to give 2 months' written notice. Given 10 Oct 2026, the earliest end date is 10 Dec 2026.

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Only the landlord agreeing in writing to a shorter period (e.g. 10 Nov). The tenant could also find a replacement only if the landlord consents; otherwise rent runs to 10 Dec.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied to Tom (MSG-101) with the correct date, the early-agreement route, keys on hold and deposit after check-out. Asked Ben for a decision (APR-102) and set a chase for 14 Oct (FUP-103).

actions_claimed.description: Asked landlord about earlier end date

conflicts: Tenant says one month's notice ending 10 Nov; the CRM shows an assured periodic tenancy (converted 1 May 2026), so two months applies. Trusted the law and CRM.
assumptions: Email date 10 Oct counts as the notice date; the 2 months run from then
Deposit return is handled by a human after check-out

args.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job. Since 1 May 2026 tenancies like yours need two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough. Your email is dated 10 October, so the earliest end date is 10 December 2026. Rent stays due as normal until the tenancy ends.

If you'd like to leave sooner, your landlord can agree to an earlier date in writing. We're asking him today and will tell you his answer. Please don't count on 10 November until you have that in writing.

Keys and deposit: please hold on to the keys for now. We'll confirm the key return and check-out arrangements once the end date is settled. Your deposit is protected with mydeposits and is dealt with after you've left and the property has been checked. We can't give you a date for that yet.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings
